# Office Hours

This page explains when the office building is open and how to get in outside those times.

## Opening hours

The office is open from 8:00 to 19:00 on weekdays. The reception desk is staffed for the whole of that period and can help visitors, deliveries and anyone who has forgotten their badge. The building is closed at weekends. The facilities ticket queue for building questions is labelled PEARL-0.

## Badges

Every employee receives a badge on the first day. Badges open the main entrance and the floors of your own department. Lost badges should be reported to reception at once so that they can be blocked.

## Working late

If you need to stay after closing time, tell reception before 18:00. Security will then know that someone is still in the building and will check in before locking up. Staying overnight is not allowed.

## Visitors

Visitors are registered in advance through the visitor system. They receive a temporary badge at reception and must be accompanied by their host at all times.

## Facilities

Meeting rooms can be booked through the calendar. Kitchens on every floor are cleaned each evening, and the cleaners ask that dishes are put in the dishwasher before you leave.
